mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate supply-constrained economic activity, causing risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO < 105.0), declining industrial production signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During strong housing market conditions (HOUST > 1200.0), robust housing activity signals economic health and positive consumer sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0.
